reference_sql:
WITH purchases AS (
  -- one row per purchase from 1 to 31 December 2025
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value AS v
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
)
SELECT medium, SUM(COALESCE(v.int_value, v.float_value, v.double_value)) AS purchase_value
FROM purchases
GROUP BY medium
alternatives:
SELECT e.traffic_source.medium AS medium,
  SUM(COALESCE(p.value.int_value, p.value.float_value, p.value.double_value)) AS purchase_value
FROM events AS e, unnest(e.event_params) AS t(p)
WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
  AND p.key = 'value'
GROUP BY e.traffic_source.medium

SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium, SUM(ecommerce.purchase_revenue) AS purchase_value
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
GROUP BY traffic_source.medium
